title.narrative: CORE FUNDING FOR YR 1 OF MULTI YEAR CONTRIBUTION 2023 - 2025

description.narrative: The Global Fund to fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria aims to end the three diseases.This grant is part of the multiannual 2023 - 2025 pledge of €65 million, pledged in Oct 2022 at the seventh replenishment of the Global Fund. The Global Fund was founded in 2002 as an innovative financing instrument and partnership between governments, civil society and the private sector to accelerate the end of the AIDS, TB and malaria epidemics. It provides 28%, 76% and 65% of international financing for HIV, TB and malaria respectively. Its primary goal is to end AIDS, tuberculosis and malaria, with a focus on leveraging innovations to spur faster progress. For the current strategy period (2023-2028) the objectives are People-centred Integrated Systems for Health to Deliver Impact, Resilience and Sustainability; Engagement and Leadership of Most Affected Communities to Leave No One Behind; Health Equity, Gender Equality and Human Rights; and Mobilizing Increased Resources..
